audit_report: PITCHIQ v1.1 — POST-REFINEMENT INDEPENDENT AUDIT REPORT

findings.title: No rate limiting on API endpoints
findings.evidence: No rate limiting middleware installed; any caller can flood endpoints; requirements.txt has no rate-limiting dependency
findings.user_impact: Potential Denial of Service; API abuse could degrade or disable service under load
findings.technical_impact: No request quotas or throttling; production deployment at risk
findings.recommended_fix: Add rate limiting middleware (e.g., slowapi) with per-endpoint quotas; e.g., 100 requests/min per IP

findings.title: Three.js no static fallback for reduced-motion
findings.evidence: useEffect returns early if window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; Three.js scene never initialized; canvas rendered but empty; aria-label='Animated 3D football illustration' misleading
findings.user_impact: Users preferring reduced motion get broken UI; empty canvas with misleading accessibility label
findings.technical_impact: Animation loop bypassed; three.js not initialized; potential user confusion
findings.recommended_fix: Either: (a) show static football image/graphic in reduced-motion mode, or (b) remove/change aria-label when reduced motion is preferred; add conditional rendering

findings.title: WCAG AA contrast failures on nav links and headers
findings.line: Nav links: #899185 on #0d100d (4.3:1); Header text: #9aa394 on #090b09 (3.5:1)
findings.evidence: measured via contrast-checker; #899185 on #0d100d ratio 4.3:1 fails WCAG AA normal text; #9aa394 on #090b09 ratio 3.5:1 fails WCAG AA normal text; both are design-intent choices prioritizing aesthetics over accessibility
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users and low-vision users cannot reliably navigate; header text may be unreadable
findings.technical_impact: WCAG AA non-compliance; potential legal accessibility concerns
findings.recommended_fix: Increase contrast: nav link color to #c7f36b (lime) or #f3f5ef (white); header text to #c7f36b or #f3f5ef; add outline focus styles; consider color palette review

findings.title: Inconsistent ARIA labels across components
findings.evidence: Some elements have aria-label (search input: 'Search player or club'; filter selects; comparison selects); many missing (chart containers, heatmap, table headers, navigation landmarks); Recharts components have no ARIA labels; heatmap cells have no aria-label or aria-describedby
findings.user_impact: Screen reader users get incomplete experience; cannot understand chart data or navigation context
findings.technical_impact: Reduced accessibility; screen reader usability gaps
findings.recommended_fix: Add ARIA labels to: correlation heatmap container, Recharts BarChart/Heatmap components, table headers (scope='col'), navigation landmarks (already present), comparison player selectors, leaderboard metric select

findings.title: Colour contrast on decorative headers fails WCAG AA
findings.evidence: #9aa394 (secondary text) on #090b09 background ratio 3.5:1 fails WCAG AA normal text; color is intentional decorative accent but falls below accessibility threshold
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users may not read section headers; reduces content accessibility
findings.technical_impact: WCAG AA non-compliance on decorative but functional text
findings.recommended_fix: Increase contrast: use #c7f36b (lime) or #f3f5ef (white) for header text; or reduce amount of colored header text; maintain design language while meeting minimums
findings.test_command: manual contrast measurement or npx axe

findings.title: Three.js resize handler has no debounce
findings.evidence: window.addEventListener('resize', resize) fires on every resize event; no throttling or debounce; can cause layout thrashing; particularly impactful on mobile where resize events fire frequently
findings.user_impact: Potential jank or performance degradation on window resize; especially on mobile devices
findings.technical_impact: Layout thrashing; unnecessary re-renders; GPU overhead from frequent resize handling
findings.recommended_fix: Add debounced resize handler using requestAnimationFrame or setTimeout with 100ms threshold; e.g., wrap resize callback in a debounce function that only fires after 100ms of no new resize events
findings.test_command: manual testing with rapid window resizing; or add unit test for resize behavior

findings.title: Focus styles could be more visible
findings.evidence: Nav links get box-shadow: inset 2px 0 #c7f36b on active/focus; other focusable elements (inputs, buttons) get standard browser outline; inconsistent focus indication across component types; some elements lack distinct focus styling
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users cannot easily see focus position; reduces keyboard navigability
findings.technical_impact: Usability regression for keyboard-only users; WCAG AA recommendation for clear focus indicators
findings.recommended_fix: Add explicit outline focus styles to all focusable elements: outline: 2px solid #c7f36b (or 3px); ensure consistent focus appearance; don't remove default outlines without replacement; test with keyboard-only navigation
findings.test_command: keyboard-only navigation test; tab through all interactive elements

findings.title: any types in frontend reduce type safety
findings.line: various; types.ts line 32 (Player type); api.ts request function
findings.evidence: Player type has well-defined interface but UI code may access properties without null checks; api.ts request() uses response.json() as T with implicit any; several spread operations implicitly any; reduces compile-time type checking benefit
findings.user_impact: Developers can bypass type checks; potential runtime errors when property assumed to exist is actually undefined; harder to maintain codebase
findings.technical_impact: Reduced TypeScript strict mode benefit; any spreads type uncertainty throughout codebase
findings.recommended_fix: Replace any with proper types or unknown; add runtime validation where types are narrowed; run tsc --noEmit to identify all any usages; gradually replace with specific types

findings.title: No visual skeleton states on pages
findings.line: various; LoadingBlock component present but not consistently used
findings.evidence: Several pages show 'LOADING...' text or skeleton-block but many go straight to empty state; no consistent CSS skeleton loaders or spinner components; perceived performance could be improved
findings.user_impact: Users perceive slower loading; no visual indication of progress; jarring transitions from loading to content
findings.technical_impact: Lower perceived performance; inconsistent UX across pages
findings.recommended_fix: Add CSS skeleton loaders or spinner components to all pages; use LoadingBlock component consistently; ensure loading state is shown during data fetch before empty state appears
findings.test_command: npx vitest run --environment jsdom; inspect rendered output

findings.title: Comparison select truncation at wide viewports
findings.evidence: At 1440px viewport, comparison select labels may overflow container; grid-template-columns with minmax() may not accommodate long player names 'Squad · Position (#Rk)'; ellipsis or truncation not implemented
findings.user_impact: Some player names may be cut off; incomplete information at wide viewports
findings.technical_impact: UI overflow; potential accessibility issue if truncated text is critical information
findings.recommended_fix: Add text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; or expand container width at wide viewports; test at 1440px and above
findings.test_command: resize browser to 1440px; inspect comparison page

findings.title: No export size limit
findings.evidence: Full filtered dataset can be exported as CSV; no limit or max_rows parameter; potential for very large downloads; no abuse protection beyond CSV formula injection guard
findings.user_impact: Users may download unexpectedly large files; potential abuse; bandwidth concerns
findings.technical_impact: No guard against large exports; could be exploited for DoS via large downloads
findings.recommended_fix: Add limit and max_rows parameters to export_players; default to 500 (same as players list max); or add separate export endpoint with size guard

findings.title: Hero orbit sizes fixed, not responsive
findings.evidence: Orbit sizes fixed at 350×350 and 440×440 pixels; no responsive adjustment based on container size; hero art section has responsive CSS but orbits do not adapt
findings.user_impact: Orbits may look disproportionate on mobile or narrow viewports; may overflow or look sparse
findings.technical_impact: Fixed pixel sizes; not responsive; could cause layout issues on small screens
findings.recommended_fix: Make orbit sizes responsive using CSS percentages or vw units; or conditionally adjust based on el.clientWidth; test at 390px, 768px, 1024px
findings.test_command: manual viewport resizing test; or add unit test for resize behavior

findings.title: Additional colour palette variety
findings.evidence: Current palette limited to obsidian dark (#090b09) and electric lime (#c7f36b); no secondary accent colors; purely aesthetic preference; does not affect functionality
findings.user_impact: Visual monotony; limited brand expression opportunity
findings.technical_impact: No functional impact; design refresh only
findings.recommended_fix: Add secondary accent colors optional; not blocking; could be addressed in v1.2 theming pass

findings.title: More chart annotation options
findings.evidence: Basic BarChart, LineChart, Heatmap implementations only; no annotation lines, trend indicators, or user-configurable grid lines; power users may want more statistical display options
findings.user_impact: Limited display options for advanced users; less informational density possible
findings.technical_impact: Feature gap; not blocking core functionality
findings.recommended_fix: Add optional annotation features; trend lines; grid line customization; not blocking v1.1; could be v1.2 enhancement

findings.title: Hover tooltips on correlation heatmap
findings.evidence: Heatmap cells display value and have title attribute with '× label: value'; no interactive hover tooltip with variable names or correlation interpretation; limited exploratory data experience
findings.user_impact: Reduced exploratory capability; users cannot inspect individual correlation values on hover
findings.recommended_fix: Add hover tooltip component; show variable pair and value on hover; not blocking; could use recharts Cell onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave or separate tooltip library
